outcomes.statement: Demonstrate a fundamental understanding of architecture-level support for parallelization and programming paradigms
Design and implement shared memory programs using OpenMP
Design and implement distributed memory programs using MPI
Design and construct CUDA programs using GPU architecture
Design optimized parallel solutions using thread and memory organization in CUDA
Applying Parallel Programming Concepts to Applications

lesson_plan.name: Introduction to Parallel Computing : Need of Parallelism; Forms of Parallelism, Flynn's taxonomy: SISD, SIMD, MISD, MIMD
Moore's Law and Multicore; Amdahl's Law
Speedup and performance; Programming paradigms: Comparison between Shared and Distributed Memory Programming Paradigms
Introduction to Parallel Random Access Machine (PRAM) Architecture Model: Characteristics of PRAM Models; Types of PRAM Models
Introduction to Parallel Random Access Machine (PRAM) Architecture Model: Advantages and Limitations of PRAM Models
Shared Memory Programming Using OpenMP: Introduction to OpenMP: What is OpenMP?, Shared-memory programming: Advantages and limitations, OpenMP programming model
Fork-join execution and thread-based parallelism, Compiling OpenMP Programs: Enabling OpenMP and Running programs, OpenMP Compiler Directives: parallel, for, sections, single, master
Data Sharing: Shared variables; Private variables; firstprivate; lastprivate; reduction

Synchronization: Barrier; Critical sections; Atomic operations. Runtime Functions: omp_get_thread_num(); omp_get_num_threads(); omp_set_num_threads(); omp_get_wtime(). Environment Variables: OMP_NUM_THREADS; OMP_SCHEDULE; OMP_DYNAMIC
Work Sharing: for directive; sections; single; Combined Parallel and Work-sharing constructs
Scheduling (static, dynamic, guided)
Distributed Memory Programming Using MPI: Message-Passing Programming, MPI Basics and Introduction to Distributed-Memory Architectures
Foundational Concepts of the MPI Standard; Compiling and Running MPI Programs
Point-to-Point Communication: Send/Recv Between Two Processes; Synchronous and Buffered Send
Collective Communication: Broadcast, Scatter, Gather and Reduce Operations
Collective Data Movement and Reduction; Introduction to Allgather and Alltoall
Measuring the Execution Time of MPI Programs; MPI Error-Handling Functions
Accelerated Programming Using GPU: GPU Architecture-Transition from CPU to GPU
Architecture of a Modern GPU
CUDA Program Structure and Vector-Vector Addition
Device Global Memory and Data Transfer
CUDA Kernel Functions and Threads
CUDA Thread Organization
Assigning Resources to Blocks and Querying Device Properties
Sequential and Parallel 1D Convolution
Sequential Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication and Parallel SpMV Using CSR
CUDA Atomic and Arithmetic Functions
High-Performance GPU Programming Using Optimizations: Introduction to GPU Performance Optimization
Mapping Threads to Multidimensional Data
Matrix-Matrix Multiplication: A More Complex CUDA Kernel
Synchronization and Transparent Scalability
CUDA Device Memory Types; Constant Memory and Caching
Tiled 1D Convolution with Halo Elements
Importance of Memory-Access Efficiency
Reducing Global-Memory Traffic and Tiled Matrix-Matrix Multiplication
Thread Scheduling and Latency Tolerance

CUDA Programming Basics - Vector addition & toolkit setup
Memory Management in CUDA - Host-device transfer
GPU Memory Optimization - Shared vs global memory
Warp Execution and Thread Organization in CUDA
Memory Optimization using Tiling - Matrix multiplication
Parallel Programming Case Study / Mini Project
